# The Chronicle of react/react

*13 years · 19,117 commits · 1,952 contributors · 130 releases*

react/react began on 29 May 2013, with Ben Newman’s first commit. In the 13 years since, 1,952 hands have laid 19,117 commits, and the island has grown to 7,252 files. Its story is told in six chapters, one for each major release.

## I. The First Stones

*May 2013 – April 2016 · 988 files at its end*

The island rose from the sea with 317 files and grew to 988, over 4,261 commits.

- Ben Newman laid the first stone: a first commit of 317 files, in `src`, `docs`, `examples` and two more places.
- The guild grew by 155 hands; Sebastian Markbåge and Dan Abramov would do the most.
- `v0.3.0` went out: the first galleon left the harbour.
- The busiest week began on 29 May 2013: 114 commits.
- The first stones of `scripts` were laid; in time it would hold 228 files.
- `packages/react-dom` broke new ground; in time it would hold 249 files.
- `npm-react-codemod` took a new name: `packages/react-codemod`.
- `packages/react-codemod` sank back into the sea after four months.
- Besides, two smaller places rose and one more place sank.
- 29 more releases followed, from `v0.3.3` to `v0.14.8`.

## II. The Age of v15

*April 2016 – September 2017 · v15.0.0 · 1,227 files at its end*

The island grew from 988 files to 1,227, over 2,354 commits, release by release.

- A new major, `v15.0.0`: the town turned out to see the galleon off.
- 41 new hands joined the guild, Brian Vaughn and Dominic Gannaway among them.
- `packages/react-native-renderer` was founded, and a new place rose from the sea.
- In the week of 16 November 2016 the hammers never stopped: 72 commits.
- `fixtures` was founded, and a new place rose from the sea; in time it would hold 566 files.
- `examples` sank back into the sea after four years.
- Besides, three smaller places rose and two more places sank.
- 20 more releases followed, from `v15.0.1` to `v15.6.1`.

## III. The Old Ground Cleared

*September 2017 – October 2020 · v16.0.0 · 1,927 files at its end*

Across three years the island grew from 1,227 files to 1,927, over 4,425 commits.

- The guild grew by 51 hands; Sebastian “Sebbie” Silbermann and Ricky would do the most.
- `v16.0.0` set sail, a new major, and the harbour hung out its bunting.
- The island shrank from 1,212 files to 680 as old ground was cleared.
- `docs` sank back into the sea after four years.
- A new place rose from the sea: `packages/react-reconciler`; in time it would hold 197 files.
- In the week of 3 April 2019 the hammers never stopped: 133 commits.
- `packages/events` took a new name: `packages/legacy-events`.
- `packages/react-devtools-shared` broke new ground; in time it would hold 614 files.
- Besides, 25 smaller places rose, two more places took new names and two more places sank.
- 37 more releases followed, from `v15.6.2` to `v16.14.0`.

## IV. The Age of v17

*October 2020 – March 2022 · v17.0.0 · 2,423 files at its end*

The island grew from 1,927 files to 2,423, over 1,210 commits, release by release.

- `v17.0.0` went out under full sail: the age of v17 began.
- 15 new hands joined the guild, Josh Story and Mengdi Chen among them.
- A new place rose from the sea: `packages/react-server-dom-relay`.
- `packages/react-transport-dom-webpack` took a new name: `packages/react-server-dom-webpack`.
- The busiest week began on 24 March 2021: 37 commits.
- The first stones of `packages/use-sync-external-store` were laid.
- Besides, one smaller place rose and one more place took a new name.
- Two more releases followed: `v17.0.1` and `v17.0.2`.

## V. The Rise of `compiler`

*March 2022 – November 2024 · v18.0.0 · 6,932 files at its end*

Across three years the island more than doubled, from 2,423 files to 6,932, over 4,808 commits.

- `v18.0.0` set sail, a new major, and the harbour hung out its bunting.
- The guild grew by 25 hands; Lauren Tan and Sathya Gunasekaran would do the most.
- `packages/react-dom-bindings` was founded, and a new place rose from the sea.
- The busiest week began on 31 January 2024: 101 commits.
- `packages/react-interactions` sank back into the sea after five years.
- The first stones of `compiler` were laid; in time it would hold 4,282 files.
- Three great reshapings: one commit moved and remade 3,669 files, another 1,898.
- Besides, five smaller places rose.
- Five more releases followed, from `v18.1.0` to `eslint-plugin-react-hooks@5.0.0`.

## VI. The Age of v19

*November 2024 – October 2026 · v19.0.0 · 7,252 files at its end*

The island grew from 6,932 files to 7,252, over 2,052 commits, release by release.

- `v19.0.0` went out under full sail: the age of v19 began.
- `packages/react-server-dom-parcel` broke new ground.
- Eleven new hands joined the guild, Eugene Choi and Jorge Cabiedes among them.
- A single commit reshaped 1,146 files.
- The busiest week began on 12 March 2025: 63 commits.
- A new place rose from the sea: `packages/react-server-dom-unbundled`.
- `packages/react-devtools-timeline` was cleared away, five years after it was founded.
- Besides, two smaller places rose.
- 31 more releases followed, from `v19.1.0` to `v19.3.0`.

---

*The tale is still being written: the island stands at 7,252 files in 37 places, and the last stone was laid on 7 October 2026.*

- II The Age of v15 | April 2016 – September 2017 | v15.0.0 | 1227 files | 2354 commits
